row.evidence: Gusto's Okta integration is available only on Plus or Premium, provisions from Gusto into Okta, and the integration does not support SSO functionality. No Gusto page documents an inbound SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: No inbound SCIM on any plan. Gusto's 'provisioning apps' are outbound: Gusto is the HR source that creates and removes accounts in Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and others. Okta's OIN entry for Gusto is SWA-only. No SAML SSO is documented (users can link Google or Intuit sign-in). Pricing is a monthly base fee plus a per-person fee for each person paid, not per admin seat, and no contract is required, so per-user numbers are null. The Gusto REST API is partner-only and not available to customers on any plan, so user_api is partner_only. Status unchanged from June (none). Under the post-pilot rules the SWA-only Okta app maps to idp.okta none, and scim.available is null rather than false because no Gusto page says SCIM is not offered.

limitations.text: No Gusto page documents an inbound SCIM endpoint. Gusto's 'provisioning apps' run the other way: Gusto is the source and creates/removes accounts in connected apps (Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, etc.). There is no explicit 'no SCIM' statement, so scim.available is null; the none status rests on this documented outbound-only model plus the absence of any SCIM documentation.
Gusto's own Okta integration (Plus or Premium only) creates and removes Okta accounts from Gusto and explicitly does not support SSO.

Okta's OIN entry for Gusto (last updated Jul. 24 2019) marks only SWA as a checked capability in the page markup; SAML, SCIM and all provisioning capabilities (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push) are unchecked.

endpoints.purpose: Delete an employee who is still onboarding (onboarded employees return 422)
List company admins (read-only in App Integrations)
Create an admin (Gusto Embedded API reference only)
List departments with assigned employees and contractors
Create a webhook subscription (system access token)

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per minute per OAuth grant (60-second rolling window); 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: The API is restricted to approved App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners (Production Pre-Approval and security review required). Gusto customers cannot use it to connect their own systems to their own account, on any plan. It is not plan-gated, so api_tax is left null rather than true or false.

Gusto's comparison page says App Integrations cannot terminate or rehire employees (Embedded only), but the App Integrations API reference lists termination and rehire endpoints. The two vendor pages conflict.
Admin accounts can only be listed through App Integrations; admin creation appears only in the Gusto Embedded reference.
Customer-facing alternatives are the Gusto MCP server and the Gusto CLI (beta). Both are documented as payroll and people-data tools, not as user-provisioning APIs.
Pagination: page/per query parameters, default 25 per page.

okta.notes: Only SWA (password-vaulted sign-in) is checked in the OIN page markup; no SAML/OIDC, SCIM or provisioning, so sso is false under the post-pilot SWA rule. Gusto's separate Okta integration provisions from Gusto into Okta (opposite direction) and states it does not support SSO.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: Gusto acts as the HR source and creates/suspends/deletes accounts in connected apps (Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack and others). Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 provisioning are on all plans; the other provisioning apps need Plus or Premium. Users can sign in with a linked Google or Intuit account.

open_questions: No Gusto page explicitly says 'we do not support SCIM'; the none status rests on the documented outbound-only provisioning model and the absence of any inbound SCIM docs.
No SAML/OIDC SSO plan documented. Gusto's Okta page says the integration does not support SSO; whether any plan offers SAML SSO is undocumented, so sso_plan is null.
Microsoft Entra: no Learn tutorial found for Gusto (the expected gusto-tutorial and gusto-provisioning-tutorial URLs return 404). Gallery listing not verified.
Google Workspace: no Google admin help page or Marketplace entry found that lists Gusto as a SAML or provisioning app.

OneLogin: connector pages (onelogin.com/connector/gusto_formservice and /zenpayroll) returned an AWS WAF bot challenge to both curl and headless browser. Listing, SSO type and provisioning not verified.

JumpCloud: JumpCloud describes an HRIS integration with Gusto (Gusto as source into JumpCloud) but no JumpCloud page that mentions Gusto could be loaded and quoted. Provisioning into Gusto is not documented.
CSV/spreadsheet import of employees: help-centre search surfaced only payroll-data Smart Import; bulk employee import was not verified.
Whether Gusto lets admins enforce Google sign-in or set any company-wide SSO policy is undocumented.
